sections.indications_and_usage: Uses For temporary relief of minor aches and pains of muscles and joints associated with: arthritis simple backache sprains strains bruises
sections.dosage_and_administration: Directions adults and children 2 years of age and older: apply to the affected area no more than 3 to 4 times daily children under 2 years of age; consult a doctor
sections.warnings_and_cautions: Warnings For external use only. Use only as directed. Flammable Keep away from fire, flame, sparks and heated surfaces. Tighten cap firmly.
